doc: The body job/ beside this folder writes by adding a task to tasks: [], ../added.yml, read back through the same binding (FBL 0.10, section 6.2; spec 066, User Story 2, scenario 4): the job holds one task, first, the one added.

steps.doc: The added task is a task like any other: setting its run_if inserts the key after its task_key.

expectFiles.../added.yml:
resources:
  jobs:
    empty_flow:
      name: Tasks written as an empty flow sequence
      tasks:
        - task_key: first
          run_if: ALL_DONE
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/first
    flow_dependencies:
      name: Dependencies written on one line
      tasks:
        - task_key: a
          notebook_task: {notebook_path: notebooks/a}
        - task_key: b
          depends_on: [{task_key: a}]
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/b
        - task_key: c
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/c
  pipelines:
    flow_pipeline:
      name: Flow pipeline
      libraries: [{notebook: {path: transformations/one}}, {file: {path: transformations/two.py}}]
